claim_boundary: Report only that a named target failed or succeeded under a named protocol, method, round, and vantage set; never publish a national censorship percentage from this panel.

evidence_controls.purpose: Distinguish a target- or protocol-specific failure from broad reachability loss.
Retain before-and-after public policy and webpage evidence without treating archive absence as deletion proof.
Compare app availability across declared storefronts and rounds.

method: Normalize consented aggregate inputs into immutable round receipts; require a recorded synchronization window and declared geographic/control minima before a round enters a longitudinal comparison.

protocol_capabilities.limitation: Only consented datacenter ASNs are eligible; this is not a household or national sample.
protocol_capabilities.method: Globalping same-round A-record comparison from consented mainland cloud probes
